answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by completing escrowed jobs whose results are independently checked, with each job requiring a distinct counterparty and a bond that is slashed for fraud. This makes a pile of fresh identities worth little: Sybils need real funds, must persuade independent clients, and risk losing collateral when they collude or submit fake work. A marble design, timber estimate, or knoll survey counts only after verification, so names alone cannot manufacture reputation; the attacker pays in capital, time, and failed bonds.
